## Summary / Özet

Describe the user-visible outcome and scope.  
Kullanıcıya yansıyan sonucu ve kapsamı açıklayın.

## Validation / Doğrulama

- [ ] make test passes
- [ ] No secrets, private IPs, SSH material, or user data
- [ ] Provider boundaries remain fail-closed
- [ ] TR/EN documentation is synchronized
- [ ] Upgrade and rollback impact is documented
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated when user-visible
- [ ] Live tests are opt-in, redacted, and cost-aware

## Evidence / Kanıt

Provide exact commands, exit status, environment, and redacted results. Local diagnostics or mocks must not be represented as real provider availability.

Tam komut, exit status, ortam ve redact edilmiş sonuç ekleyin. Local diagnostic veya mock, gerçek provider erişilebilirliği olarak sunulmamalıdır.

## Security / Güvenlik

Explain any change to credentials, endpoints, downloaded artifacts, privileges, tmux sessions, logs, or network behavior.
